attr.title: Hollow Knight
attr.desc: Hollow Knight, the hand-drawn action adventure by Team Cherry, on Unity's own Android player (run natively, no emulator). You need your own copy: the GOG Linux version.
attr.inst: Put the GOG Linux installer (hollow_knight_*.sh) or the installed game folder into ports/hollowknight/gamedata, then launch. The first launch builds the game on the handheld.
